2. Understand our API documentation: Our API documentation should provide details on the API endpoints (URLs), parameters, request methods (GET, POST, etc.), data formats (JSON, XML, etc.), and response structures. You can reach out to support or search our documentation for the API documentation.

3. Implement API requests: Depending on your system's programming language, you'll need to make HTTP requests to the appropriate API endpoints using the information provided in the documentation.

4. Handle responses: Your system needs to be able to parse and understand the responses it receives from our API.

5. Secure the connection: If required, use HTTPS to ensure secure communication between your system and our API.

6. Error handling: Implement error handling to manage various possible API response scenarios.

Since there's no specific guidance available, I recommend contacting our support team during our support hours (09:00 to 17:30, Monday to Friday) to get step-by-step instructions for integrating our API with your specific system. They will be able to provide you with the appropriate information based on your needs.
